publication: Wang et al. Nature Cancer 2022, PMID 36539501
canonical_verdict_rationale: Two independent modalities analyzed. Neither supports SC_ESCAPE_SUPPORTED. Spatial (Visium): SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET — assay structurally incapable of per-cell EMT scoring (mixed-cell spots, 1825-gene panel, cross-sectional n=5). snRNA-seq (matched pairs, n=8): SC_UNDERPOWERED — correct assay, correct normalization (CP10K + log1p), correct test (Wilcoxon signed-rank), but n=8 provides ~20% power to detect Cohen's d=0.5. Mesenchymal shift present in 4/8 pairs (50%), directionally consistent with Wang et al. ~60% rate. The biology is not absent; the analysis is underpowered.

verdict_taxonomy.SC_ESCAPE_SUPPORTED: ≥3/4 signatures p<0.05 by Wilcoxon signed-rank (one-sided) in snRNA-seq matched pairs
verdict_taxonomy.SC_MIXED_SIGNAL: ≥1 signature significantly UP and ≥1 significantly DOWN (p<0.05) — directionally inconsistent
verdict_taxonomy.SC_UNDERPOWERED: Correct assay, correct analysis, p>0.05 due to insufficient n — biology not excluded
verdict_taxonomy.SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET: Assay structurally incapable of answering the question (wrong modality, missing genes, bulk resolution)
verdict_taxonomy.SC_ESCAPE_ABSENT: ≥3/4 signatures significantly DOWN (p<0.05) in adequately powered analysis — NOT assigned here

visium_spatial.failure_mode: mixed-cell spots + targeted panel + cross-sectional design
visium_spatial.visium_mixed_cell_limitation: Visium spots (~55 µm, 1-10 cells) capture expression from all cell types. Mesenchymal markers (CD44, VIM, TGFB1) are expressed by macrophages AND tumor cells — spot-level scoring cannot distinguish tumor-cell EMT from macrophage infiltration. Wang et al. reported the mesenchymal shift is driven by macrophage infiltration, making this confound critical.

snrna_seq_matched_pairs.biological_consistency: Mesenchymal UP in 4/8 pairs (50%) — directionally consistent with Wang et al. reported ~60% rate. Macrophage UP in 3/8 pairs. High inter-patient heterogeneity is the expected biology, not noise.
